SASBDB entry SASDHX2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDHX2/)

Publication: Lisnyansky Bar-El et al. (2019), Biomolecules 9, 660
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.3390/biom9110660

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDHX2.dat   the curve (columns q, I, error)
  SASDHX2_fit1.fit              the FoXS fit of "fit1"
  SASDHX2_fit1_model1.pdb: MODELLER homology model of the DHDDS dimer; the .dat is in 1/nm
Only fit1 is used. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDHX2/ (buffer, temperature and wavelength: see its header comments).
Added 2026-11-15; not yet run.
